|rulings=* Although characters here cannot be excluded from battle, a card like [[Rebel Barrier]] or [[Clash Of Sabers]] might prevent a battle from being initiated in the first place, particularly if used on a character who is alone. Once a battle is successfully initiated (such as by having another non-Barriered character), no characters will be excluded.<ref name="scomp">card data [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Light.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* Characters can be made immediately lost (e.g. via [[Blaster Proficiency]]) as this is not exclusion.
